## ✅ Pre-Submission Checklist

- [ ] **100% D-Pad Navigable:** All new UI elements, dialogs, and overlays can be reached and operated cleanly using only a 5-way D-Pad (`Up`, `Down`, `Left`, `Right`, `OK`, `Back`) with visible focus states.
- [ ] **Performance Mode Compatible:** Heavy animations respect the Control Panel's **Performance Mode** toggle.
- [ ] **No Hardcoded Secrets:** Zero developer API keys, tokens, or credentials are included in the code.
- [ ] **Local-First Privacy:** User data, sessions, and logs remain stored strictly on-device.
- [ ] **Clean Build:** The project compiles cleanly without new Gradle or Kotlin compiler warnings.
